title: Home to Room Eight  (팔 호실로 돌아온 걸음)

segments.t: 메인주 포틀랜드의 린든 코트야드 여관 안뜰에 다정한 박수 소리가 잔물결처럼 번지고, 이웃들은 그늘나무 아래 자리한 귀한 손님에게 반갑게 인사를 건넵니다. 안쪽 프런트 데스크에서는 해나와 아서, 케일럽이 입가에 환한 미소를 띤 채 일 번 테이블로 들고 나갈 특별한 보물 두 가지를 챙기고 있어요. 먼저 세 사람의 대화를 들어 보세요.
Did you see my old teacher beam when he saw the green shutters open, Arthur?!
He recognized our old walnut piano through the glass before he took three steps!
And he remembered your name right on the station platform, did he not, Caleb?
Called me Front-Row Notebook before I even lowered the compass welcome sign!
He whispered that his voice is hoarse from talking on the long train ride.
No wonder he patted his coat pocket — he brought a toast card for us!
First let me bring out my family green guest book opened to May thirty years ago.
And may we lend him brass key number eight from the wooden board for the afternoon?
Room Eight is empty tonight — better yet, Hannah, Room Eight is his on the house!
He also handed Owen a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper at the gate.
Oooh, a flat parcel from a master mapmaker? Do not peek until after cake!
Carry out the brass compass and key number eight — Room Nine is ready for music!
삼십 년 만의 감격스러운 재회를 한 문장씩 차근차근 되짚어 볼까요.
Did you see my old teacher beam when he saw the green shutters open, Arthur?!
'초록색 덧창이 활짝 열린 걸 보셨을 때 제 옛 은사님이 환하게 미소 짓던 모습 보셨나요, 아서 씨?!'
He recognized our old walnut piano through the glass before he took three steps!
'세 걸음도 미처 떼기 전에 유리창 너머로 우리 낡은 호두나무 피아노를 단번에 알아보더군요!'
And he remembered your name right on the station platform, did he not, Caleb?
'게다가 기차역 승강장 한복판에서 케일럽 씨 이름까지 바로 기억해 내셨지요, 그렇지 않나요?'
Called me Front-Row Notebook before I even lowered the compass welcome sign!
'제가 나침반 환영 팻말을 채 내리기도 전에 저를 맨 앞줄 공책이라고 부르시지 뭐예요!'
He whispered that his voice is hoarse from talking on the long train ride.
'긴 기차 여행 내내 이야기를 나누느라 목소리가 쉬었다고 나직이 속삭이더군요.'
No wonder he patted his coat pocket — he brought a toast card for us!
'어쩐지 외투 주머니를 토닥이시더니 우리를 위해 건배사 카드를 챙겨 오신 거였네요!'
First let me bring out my family green guest book opened to May thirty years ago.
'우선 삼십 년 전 오월 페이지가 펼쳐진 우리 집안의 초록색 방명록부터 꺼내 갈게요.'
And may we lend him brass key number eight from the wooden board for the afternoon?
'그리고 오늘 오후 동안 나무 열쇠판에 걸린 팔 호실 황동 열쇠도 선생님께 빌려 드리면 어떨까요?'
Room Eight is empty tonight — better yet, Hannah, Room Eight is his on the house!
'팔 호실은 오늘 밤 비어 있으니 — 아니, 한술 더 떠서 해나 씨, 오늘 밤 팔 호실은 여관 대접으로 무료예요!'
He also handed Owen a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper at the gate.
'대문 앞에서는 갈색 크라프트지로 감싼 납작한 나무 꾸러미도 오언 형에게 건네주셨어요.'
Oooh, a flat parcel from a master mapmaker? Do not peek until after cake!
'어머나, 거장 지도 제작자님이 주신 납작한 꾸러미라고요? 케이크 다 먹기 전까지는 몰래 엿보기 없기예요!'
Carry out the brass compass and key number eight — Room Nine is ready for music!
'황동 나침반이랑 팔 호실 열쇠를 들고 나갑시다 — 구 호실은 이제 음악을 울릴 준비가 다 끝났어요!'
이제 자연스러운 속도로 장면 전체를 다시 들어 보세요.
Did you see my old teacher beam when he saw the green shutters open, Arthur?!
He recognized our old walnut piano through the glass before he took three steps!
And he remembered your name right on the station platform, did he not, Caleb?
Called me Front-Row Notebook before I even lowered the compass welcome sign!
He whispered that his voice is hoarse from talking on the long train ride.
No wonder he patted his coat pocket — he brought a toast card for us!
First let me bring out my family green guest book opened to May thirty years ago.
And may we lend him brass key number eight from the wooden board for the afternoon?
Room Eight is empty tonight — better yet, Hannah, Room Eight is his on the house!
He also handed Owen a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper at the gate.
Oooh, a flat parcel from a master mapmaker? Do not peek until after cake!
Carry out the brass compass and key number eight — Room Nine is ready for music!
승강장에서 맨 앞줄 공책이라는 정겨운 별명으로 불린 케일럽의 얼굴에 웃음꽃이 피어나고, 팔 호실은 오늘 밤 여관의 무료 선물로 준비됩니다. 다음 장면에서는 고소한 향기가 가득한 카페 코너에서 만나요!
See you soon!
